Quantum 1.5.0 was certified on 2026-07-13. It pins **nucleus v1.3.0**, **quark v1.2.2** and **orbit v1.3.0**.

A minor release of the suite after Quantum 1.4.0: nucleus goes from v1.2.0 to v1.3.0 (minor), quark stays at v1.2.2 and orbit stays at v1.3.0.
